primary_interest.quote: you're looking at replacing your IVR with voice AI agents

use_case.quote: we have the legacy IVR. Press one, press two, that kind of thing. ... We want something more modern. More conversational.

competitors_voice.quote: We've been playing with Retell AI for some prototypes. And Twilio is, well, we've used Twilio for other things, so it's in the mix.

decision_criteria.quote: it's hard to tell what a month will look like. With a platform where call volume spikes, we really don't want surprises.
